_notes: EFFECT_LEGEND is rendered only in the Graph toolbar (EffectLegend), filtered to variants present on current graph edges, label only (description is never shown in UI).
Variant message (SENDMESSAGE/SCHEDULEMESSAGE/SCHEDULEEVENT/CREATEEVENT) and default have visuals but NO EFFECT_LEGEND entry.

PROVENANCE_TAGS descriptions are not rendered in UI. not-executed is never rendered as a Tag; the row prints "Not executed by this server" or "Not executed by this server (requires 2.{{minor}})" and is dashed/dimmed.
Colour classes are Tailwind tokens mapped to DHIS2 palette; edgeStroke is the hex used for graph edges and the action card left border in the details modal.

EFFECT_LEGEND.label: Read
EFFECT_LEGEND.description: The rule reads this field in its condition.

EFFECT_LEGEND.label: Hide
EFFECT_LEGEND.description: The rule hides a field, section, option or stage.

EFFECT_LEGEND.label: Show
EFFECT_LEGEND.description: The rule shows a field or option.

EFFECT_LEGEND.label: Assign
EFFECT_LEGEND.description: The rule assigns a value to a field.

EFFECT_LEGEND.label: Required
EFFECT_LEGEND.description: The rule makes a field required or optional.

EFFECT_LEGEND.label: Warning
EFFECT_LEGEND.description: The rule shows a warning message.

EFFECT_LEGEND.label: Error
EFFECT_LEGEND.description: The rule shows an error and blocks saving.

EFFECT_LEGEND.label: Feedback
EFFECT_LEGEND.description: The rule displays text or a key-value pair in the feedback widget.

PROVENANCE_TAGS.label: Simulated
PROVENANCE_TAGS.description: The effect was evaluated in the browser and has no server report to compare with.
PROVENANCE_TAGS.when: Notification/event row from the browser trace whose (ruleId, actionType) is not in the last Verify with server report (notifications are never in the report, so they always stay Simulated)

PROVENANCE_TAGS.label: Server-verified
PROVENANCE_TAGS.description: The browser and the server both produced this effect.
PROVENANCE_TAGS.when: Browser trace effect also present in the dry-run report (same ruleId + actionType)

PROVENANCE_TAGS.label: Server only
PROVENANCE_TAGS.description: The server reported this effect but the browser did not simulate it.
PROVENANCE_TAGS.when: Dry-run report entry with no matching browser effect

PROVENANCE_TAGS.label: Not executed by this server
PROVENANCE_TAGS.description: The server version does not execute this action type, so it is shown for reference only.
PROVENANCE_TAGS.when: Action type not executed by server minor (SCHEDULEEVENT/CREATEEVENT < 2.43) or declared-but-not-executed (CREATEEVENT always)
